This is an estimate for generally healthy adults — a suggestion, not medical advice.

Water needs vary by person, activity and climate. Some conditions — kidney disease, dialysis, heart or liver failure — may require a lower limit set by your doctor, while others (such as kidney stones) may need more. Drinking very large amounts in a short time can be harmful. If you have a medical condition, are pregnant, or take medication that affects fluids, set your goal together with your doctor. Waterbud does not provide medical advice.
